data.name: Alam
data.gender_notes: Alam is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic ʿālam, 'world, universe', from the root ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m), 'to know'. Its root is ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m). A common Muslim given name. Alam is a Arabic name meaning “World; universe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Alam expresses “World; universe”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic ʿālam, 'world, universe', from the root ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m), 'to know'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alam total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
